Photos.Caption: The other's are jealous of the new kid in town!

Results.ReviewText:
Perfect grill for empty-nesters, young couples, and the like. Just the right size for dinners for two! Much more efficient with propane than firing up the big grill and faster & less fuss than breaking out the charcoal. The Q is now my #1 grill and all the others are relegated to "special events". The design of the Q is very well thought out and all of the accessories, such as the cart, the 20lb tank hose, and even the grill cover work seamlessly together - Like they were actually designed to work as a system!
And yet, you can quickly ditch all the extras, grab one of the little 1lb propane tanks you get from the hardware store, and head out with a light, self-contained, set-up that's perfect for a picnic at the beach or tailgating - the Q is versatile! 
I was concerned prior to purchasing the Q that it might not have enough BTUs to get that perfect sear. Absolutely NOT an issue! I'm not sure if it's the burner design, the burner spacing, or whatever magic Weber's come up with but it cooks like it's BTU rating is 5X greater than stated!
Simply put, the Weber Q is awesome! I only wish I'd gotten one sooner.
Results.Title: Unlike a certain other "Q"... This Q is for REAL!

ClientResponses.Response:
Thank you for your feedback. Your grill should easily reach 450F or higher. If you are not having that experience, we are here to help!

If you are using your grill with the adapter hose to a larger 20 lb. refill/exchange LP tank, it sounds like your grill may be in a safety mode known as “bypass." What’s happening is that the regulator thinks there’s a gas leak, so it reduces the pressure. Follow these instructions to reset the bypass safety mode. This is also the way you would want to start your grill each and every time.

Open the lid
Make sure the control knob is in the off position
Turn your LP tank on all the way
Wait 60 seconds
Turn the burner to start/high (first position to the left)
Hit your igniter
Close the lid to preheat to 450-500F.

Our Care team is here to help! Please look for our email follow-up soon. Thank you!

Results.ReviewText: I have a Weber Summit E-670. I cooked so great that I wanted a smaller one for camping. The Q1200 works so well and is so portable and convenient that I no longer use my Summit E-670. Fast forward a few years and all still working like the day it was new, I bought this Q1200 for my son (He's 11 and loves watching me cook. Now, he does it on his own! What a feeling having your 11 year old cook you hamburgers, hotdogs, and steak!). Once you experience how easy it is to take camping, boating, or picnicking with you, you'll find yourself using it even more and wonder how you've ever grilled without it. I've had cheaper grills in the past - the ones that rusted out and end up replacing more often than I'd like. I've had this one for four years now. Looks like the day it was bought and cooks the same as well. You can't beat the quality, and they come in a variety of colors - I got the green one for my son because it's his favorite colors and the green top looks like a Ninja Turtle grill to him.
Results.Title: Cooks so great, I bought this one for my son.
